name: Mizumaki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Mizumaki town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mizumaki, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1950.

features.role: Mizumaki town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
